source: 551 Coming One After Another
target: 551: Uno post alium venturi

source: 551 Coming One After Another
target: 551: Uno post alium venturi

source: As Lumian observed Noelia disappearing down the corridor, he pondered the idea of adding another catchphrase: “You Feynapotterians.”
target: Cum Lumian Noeliam in corrido evanescere aspexit, excogitavit addere dictum celebre: "Vos Feynapotteriani."

source: Nevertheless, Noelia’s kindness served as a reminder that delving into the sea prayer ritual wasn’t a straightforward endeavor.
target: Nihilominus, benignitas Noeliae admonitionem ferebat quod in ritum orationis maris penetrare non esset res simplex.

source: The associated risks demanded the Church of Earth Mother’s serious consideration.
target: Pericula consociata exigebant gravem considerationem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

source: Despite this, Lumian believed that many dangers could be sidestepped, and he wasn’t inclined to actively confront them.
target: Hac non obstante, Lumian credebat multa pericula vitari posse, nec se ad illora actuose oppugnanda inclinare.

source: His primary objective wasn’t to unveil the truth behind the sea prayer ritual and eradicate the influence of folklore on Port Santa, preventing its inhabitants from transforming into monsters.
target: Propositum principale eius non erat veritatem de ritu orationis maris detegere et vim fabularum in Portu Santa eradicare, ne incolae in monstra converterentur.

source: His true goal lay in unraveling the details of the April Fool’s prank to track down Ultraman and Bard, executing them one by one.
target: Verus autem finem eius constituit detegere subtilitates ludicri Aprilis ut Ultraman et Bard deprehenderet atque eos singillatim interfeceret.

source: With Port Santa plagued by numerous problems and abscesses, Lumian saw no need to expose them; he could withdraw in a timely manner.
target: Cum Portu Santa multis difficultatibus et abscessibus vexaretur, Lumian non videbat necessitatem eos patefacere; sufficiebat ut tempore recederet.

source: Concealing his true motives was a fundamental principle of acting as a Conspirer!
target: Occultare veras causas suas erat praeceptum fundamentale agendi ut Conspirator!

source: This could lead others to misinterpret his decisions and react incorrectly during critical moments.
target: Hoc alios ad decisiones eius male interpretandas et in momentis criticis male agendum inducere poterat.

source: After shutting the door, Lumian grabbed the golden straw hat and settled into the recliner.
target: Postquam ostium clausit, Lumian cepit pileum stramineum aureum et in sellā reclinata consedit.

source: Smirking at the corridor, he muttered to himself with interest, Who will be the next to provide information?
target: Subridens ad corrido, se ipso cum studio submurmuravit: "Quis erit proximus informationem praebendus?"

source: Rubió Paco, who clearly dislikes the Maidens of the Sea and detests such matters, or the families who have lost their positions as committee members of the Fisheries Guild for many years?
target: Rubió Paco, qui manifeste puellas Maris oderit et talia detestatur, aut familias quae per multos annos munera membrorum Consilii Gildae Piscandi amiserunt?

source: Beneath the bright sunlight outside the window, Lumian swiftly flipped through the textbooks he had purchased, hoping to memorize and grasp more relevant knowledge.
target: Sub splendenti solis luce extra fenestram, Lumian celeriter pervolvit libros doctrinales quos emit, sperans plura notitiae utiles memoriter retinere ac intellegere.

source: He couldn’t wait until the charms’ effects wore off, leaving nothing in his mind.
target: Non poterat exspectare ut effectus incantamentorum evanuerent, nihil in mente reliquentes.

source: About an hour later, unfamiliar footsteps echoed through the corridor.
target: Circiter post unam horam, vestigia ignota per corrido resonaverunt.

source: Knock, knock, knock.
target: Tunc, tunc, tunc.

source: Another knock resonated on his door.
target: Aliud pulsus in ostio eius resonavit.

source: “Who is it?” Lumian inquired in simple Highlander.
target: “Quis est?” inquit Lumian in lingua simplici Highlander.

source: “The book you bought has arrived,” the motel owner, Otta Guillaume, replied in Intisian.
target: “Liber quem emis advenit,” respondit dominus moteli, Otta Guillaume, in Intisian.

source: The book I bought?
target: Liber quem emis?

source: When have I ever bought a book?
target: Quando librum umquam emi?

source: Lumian pondered, standing up thoughtfully.
target: Lumian meditatus est, surgens animo diligenter.

source: He opened the door and received a cheaply packaged but colorful book from the old man.
target: Ostium aperuit et accepit librum parvo pretio sarcinatum sed variegatum a senex.

source: The title of the book was “Travel around Feynapotter.”
target: Titulus libri erat "Iter per Feynapotter."

source: Lumian pretended not to get the title written in Highlander and chuckled at himself.
target: Lumian simulavit se non comprehendere titulum scriptum in lingua Highlander et de se ipsos subridens.

source: “I’ll have to wait for my interpreter to swing back and decode it for me. Might not even wrap my head around it before I bid Feynapotter farewell by flipping through a dictionary.”
target: "Exspectare mihi oportet interpretem meum redeuntem et id mihi enucleandum. Forte quidem ne prorsus intellegam id, antequam Feynapottere vale dicam per perlustrationem dictionarii."

source: Otta Sr. expressed his understanding.
target: Otta Senior suam intellegentiam exprimuit.

source: “When I first landed in Port Santa, seven or eight mates shared an Intisian-Highlander dictionary.
target: "Cum primum in Portu Santa adveni, septem vel octo sodales unum dictionarium Intisiano-Highlander communicaverunt.

source: None of us dared to venture out solo.
target: Nemo nostrorum ausus est solus egredi.

source: But after hanging around a bit and pushing ourselves to chat with the locals, we gradually got the hang of it.
target: Sed post aliquod tempus versantes et nos ad locutionem cum vernaculis impellentes, paulatim consuetudinem ei attiguimus.

source: Truth be told, Highlander’s quite similar to Intisian.
target: Re veritate, lingua Highlander valde similis est Intisianae.

source: Lumian chatted briefly with Otta Sr. before heading back to his room, sinking into the recliner with “Travel around Feynapotter” in hand.
target: Lumian breviter cum Otta Senior locutus est antequam ad cellam suam rediret, consedens in sellā reclinata cum "Iter per Feynapotter" in manu.

source: He turned the book over, gripping its spine and giving it a shake.
target: Librum vertit, costam eius arripiendo et eum concussit.

source: A folded white paper tumbled out.
target: Excidit charta alba plicata.

source: Lumian caught it and flicked it open with a swift motion.
target: Lumian eam cepit et celeriter aperuit.

source: Written on it was Intisian:
target: In ea in lingua Intisiana scripta erat:

source: “The Maidens of the Sea are also not allowed to leave Port Santa or tie the knot with outsiders.
target: "Puellae Maris nec Portu Santa discedere neque cum externis coniunctionem nuptialem inire licebit.

source: But exceptions have cropped up over the years.
target: Sed exceptiones per annos ortae sunt.

source: “Feynapotter’s women dig romance before tying the knot and chase after love.
target: Feminæ Feynapotter ante nuptias ducendas amorem quaerunt et eum persequuntur.

source: The ladies of Port Santa are no different.
target: Mulieres Portu Santa non differunt.

source: Throughout the past millennium, plenty of Maidens of the Sea have bolted to preserve their love or freedom.
target: Per millenium praeteritum, multae Puellae Maris fugerunt ut amorem aut libertatem suam servarent.

source: Around 30 to 40 have made it out.
target: Circiter triginta ad quadraginta effugerunt.

source: The most recent case dates back over 20 years.
target: Novissimus casus plus quam viginti annos retrorsum dat.

source: A Maiden of the Sea married an Intisian and had a kid.
target: Una Puella Maris nupta est cum Intisiano et prolem peperit.

source: We’re unsure if she’s still alive because the Fisheries Guild has been hunting her down.
target: Nescimus utrum illa adhuc viva sit, quia Gildae Piscandi eam venantur.

source: Her child’s name is Nolfi.
target: Prole eius Nolfi vocatur.

source: You might know her.
target: Forsitan eam nosti.

source: She’s already back in Port Santa.
target: Iam redivit in Portu Santa.

source: Nolfi?
target: Nolfi?

source: Batna Comté’s lover?
target: Batna Comté amator?

source: She’s actually a child of a Maiden of the Sea.
target: Ea revera proles Puellae Maris est.

source: She even dragged her “partner” to Port Santa to witness the sea prayer ceremony…
target: Etiam socium suum ad Portu Santa traxit ut caerimoniam orationis maris videret…

source: Lumian sometimes felt something was off with Nolfi while on the Flying Bird, but he never guessed she was so tied up with the sea prayer ritual.
target: Lumian aliquando sensit aliquid de Nolfi esse alienum dum in "Flying Bird" navigaret, sed numquam suspicatus est eam tam implicatam in ritu orationis maris esse.

source: This made him wonder about Nolfi’s real reasons for returning to Port Santa.
target: Hoc eum ad mirandum de veris causis Nolfi ad Portu Santa redire incivit.

source: Batna Comté might find himself in a mind-boggling mess over this romantic fling.
target: Batna Comté se in perplexa confusione ob hanc amorosam relationem versari posse reputare potest.

source: Lumian’s eyes shifted down as he read the last line.
target: Oculi Lumiani deorsum versati sunt, dum ultimam lineam legebat.

source: “Once you’re out of these waters and Port Santa, the mystical powers from the sea prayer ritual weakens significantly.
target: "Quoniam ex his aquis et Portu Santa exeas, vires mysticae ex ritu orationis maris notabiliter minuantur.

source: Against folks from other regions, the Fisheries Guild mostly wrangles them using adventurers, bounty hunters, and professional assassins.”
target: Contra homines e regionibus aliis, Gildae Piscandi plerumque eos retinent per adventarios, venatores praemiatos, et sicarios professos.

source: Is this a go ahead to meddle with the sea prayer ritual and dig into it?
target: Num hoc indicat ut in ritu orationis maris immiscear et eum perscrutem?

source: As long as I could slip out of Port Santa and these waters, the Fisheries Guild’s committee members would be powerless against me?
target: Dummodo ex Portu Santa et his aquis effugere possim, membri consilii Gildae Piscandi adversus me impotentes fient?

source: Lumian had no clue about the identity of the person who delivered the paper and the intel.
target: Lumian nesciebat quis esset qui chartam atque notitias attulerit.

source: After all, he hadn’t seen many folks’ handwriting in Port Santa, but he could unmistakably sense their eagerness and anticipation.
target: Postremo, non multum scripturam hominum in Portu Santa viderat, sed eorum ardorem ac exspectationem indubitanter sentire poterat.

source: Crimson flames roared to life, consuming the white paper laden with information.
target: Flammae coccineae in vitam fremuerunt, chartam albidam cum notitiis oneratam devorantes.

source: Lumian reclined, sipping on Feynapotter Kingdom’s famed Manzan, the top-tier white wine produced in specific regions without dilution.
target: Lumian recubuit, sorbillans Manzan celeberrimum Regni Feynapotter, optimum album vinum ex regionibus certis sine diluendo productum.

source: He absentmindedly flipped through the book “Travel around Feynapotter” penned in Highlander.
target: Mente levata, pervolvit librum "Iter per Feynapotter" in lingua Highlander scriptum.

source: The author raved about Feynapotter Kingdom’s diverse culinary delights, praising beef, mutton, and pork while expressing disdain for the local tobacco, likening it to smoking chili.
target: Auctor de diversis deliciis culinae Regni Feynapotter extollens, bubulam, ovam, et porcinam laudabat, simulque tabacum locale detestans, id fumo piperis comparans.

source: After a stretch, Lugano returned to the suite with Ludwig, bearing a stack of street snacks—roasted baby octopuses, lamb loin, fried fish, potatoes, corn omelet, and pork rolls.
target: Post quacumque exercitatione, Lugano cum Ludwig ad conclavam rediit, ferens copiam cibi viarii—octopodes infantes tosti, lumbus agni, pisces fritti, tubera, omeletam de frumento maizo, et involucra porcina.

source: Lumian had long set aside “Travel around Feynapotter.”
target: Lumian diu librum "Iter per Feynapotter" deponerat.

source: He rose and addressed Lugano,
target: Surgens, Lugano allocutus est,

source: “Don’t forget to change your appearance tomorrow to fetch our new IDs. Also, figure out where Batna Comté will be in the next two days. I want to share a drink with him.”
target: "Noli oblivisci cras species tuam mutare ad cognoscendum nostra nova ID; item, invenias ubi Batna Comté in proximis duobus diebus erit. Volo cum eo potum communicare."

source: “Alright, alright.” Lugano couldn’t fathom why his employer suddenly wanted to locate the finely dressed adventurer, but he sensed it wasn’t as simple as a casual drink.
target: "Recte, recte." Lugano non potuit intellegere cur dominus eius subito viatorem eleganter vestitum detegere vellet, sed sensit id non tam simplex esse quam merus potus.

source: After assigning the task, Lumian grabbed the sun straw hat and casually mentioned as he sauntered toward the door, “I’m stepping out for a bit. I’ll be back before dinner.”
target: Munus assignato, Lumian pileum stramineum solis cepit et leviter dixit, dum ad ostium procedebat: "Exeo paulo; ante cenam revertar."

source: “D-do you need any translations?” Lugano asked instinctively.
target: "Num tibi translationes opus sunt?" inquit Lugano instinctim.

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian subridens respondit.

source: “I’m just taking a stroll, getting a feel for the terrain. No need to chat with anyone. Don’t worry, I won’t lose my way.”
target: "Modo ambulo, terram explorans. Non opus est cum aliquo colloqui. Noli solliciti esse, viam meam non aberrabo."

source: Lugano tersely acknowledged and refrained from probing further.
target: Lugano breviter assentivit et ulterius inquisire cessavit.

source: He trusted that his employer’s adept body language skills would make simple communication a breeze.
target: Confidebat dominum suum per calliditatem gestuum simplicem communicationem efficere posse.

source: Once out of Solow Motel, Lumian ambled down the street.
target: Exiit Solow Motel, et Lumian per viam lente ambulavit.

source: He aimed to set the stage for those attempting to reach him and see if the Fisheries Guild would seize the chance to make a move.
target: Intellexit fore ut illis qui eum pervenire conabantur occasionem pararet, et ut videret si membri Consilii Gildae Piscandi occasionem caperent ad agendum.

source: Solow Motel, fifth-floor suite.
target: Solow Motel, conclave in quinto tabulato.

source: As Ludwig polished off the fermented grape juice, he leaped from the chair and headed briskly to the washroom.
target: Dum Ludwig succum viniferum fermentatum perrexerat, ex sella saluit et festinanter ad latrinam profectus est.

source: Lugano slouched on the sofa, reluctant to budge.
target: Lugano in sofa incurvatus remansit, non cogens se movere.

source: After tending to the child for nearly two hours, fatigue had settled in.
target: Post curam pueri per fere duas horas egit, lassitudo se imposuit.

source: Lugano yearned for a break.
target: Lugano quietem desiderabat.

source: His plan was to gather intel on Batna Comté and rendezvous with the spirited Feynapotter ladies at the bar later in the night.
target: Propositum eius fuit de Batna Comté notitias colligere et cum animosis feminis Feynapotter postea in taberna convenire.

source: Ludwig entered the washroom, lifted the toilet lid, and half-closed his eyes.
target: Ludwig in latrinam intravit, operculum latrinae attollit, et oculos semiclusa habuit.

source: As he relieved himself with determination, a slim silhouette emerged from the shadows in the corner.
target: Dum se constanter evacuabat, gracilis figura ex umbris in angulo apparuit.

source: The black shadow took the form of an insect, about the thickness of a finger, with long bristles on its surface resembling spoiled food.
target: Umbra nigra formam insectoris assumpsit, crassitudine digiti comparata, cum longis setis in superficie, quas similes cibo corrupto videbantur.

source: Its bristles fluttered, extending like tentacles, reaching out to touch everything in its path.
target: Setae eius fluctuant, extendentes quasi tentaculi, omnia in via attingere conabantur.

source: As it twisted, the black shadow silently crept up behind Ludwig.
target: Dum se verteret, umbra nigra silentio post Ludwig se subiecit.

source: It abruptly stood up and plunged its head into Ludwig’s cervical spine.
target: Subito surrexit et caput suum in spinam cervicalem Ludovici impulit.

source: At that moment, it caught sight of the boy’s brown eyes.
target: Illo momento oculos fuscos pueri conspexit.

source: Abruptly, it froze, holding its shape like a snake rearing its upper body.
target: Subito immobilis factum est, formam suam retinens sicut serpens, qui suum corpus superius extollit.

source: Ludwig, at some point, had ceased urinating and half-turned around.
target: Ludwig, aliquando, mictionem desiit et semiclusus se convertere coepit.

source: He extended his right palm and seized the black shadow.
target: Manum dextram extendit et umbram nigram rapuit.

source: The shadow didn’t put up a fight.
target: Umbra nullam resistentiam ostendit.

source: In the next instant, the chubby boy, Ludwig, shoved the black shadow into his mouth.
target: In instante secundo, puer pinguis, Ludwig, umbram nigram in os suum coniecit.

source: Amidst distinct chewing sounds, the lower half of the shadow’s body twisted upward, melding with the blurry flesh in front of it.
target: Inter sonos masticandi distinctos, dimidia pars inferior corporis umbrae surrexit, confluitque cum carne confusa in fronte eius.

source: In the blink of an eye, Ludwig consumed the black shadow as if it were a bowl of Feynapotter noodles.
target: In ictu oculi, Ludwig umbram nigram consumpsit, velut catillus Nudorum Feynapotter.

source: He licked his lips, appearing as though he wanted another serving.
target: Labia sua lambit, quasi alteram portionem appetiret.

source: Outside Aquina Street, in the café adorned with flowers on every table.
target: Extra viam Aquina, in caupona quae in omni mensa floribus ornata erat.

source: Along the way, Lumian stumbled upon two street brawls.
target: In via, Lumian incidit in duas certationes viarias.

source: He snagged a skewer of Port Santa’s roasted octopuses for a quick bite, yet no one approached him discreetly, attempted to stuff him with something, or whispered secret messages.
target: Accepit spicula octopodum Portu Santa tostum ad celerem edendum, sed nemo secreto accessit, nihil eum implere conatus aut arcana nuntia susurravit.

source: There were no covert attacks.
target: Nullae erant incursiones clandestinae.

source: Under the radiant sky and brilliant sun, he chose a quiet corner in a café, ordering a glass of Torres coffee with milk, relishing its rich bitterness with patience.
target: Sub caelo radianti et sole fulgente, angulum quietum in caupona elegit, poculum cafeae Torres cum lacte iussit, amaritudinem eius dives patienter degustans.

source: As time drifted by, a woman donned in a blue veil and an exquisite dress suddenly took a seat across from Lumian.
target: Cum tempus laborem faceret, femina caeruleo velamine et veste exquisita repente trans Lumian consedit.

source: She scanned the surroundings and swiftly raised the blue fishnet hanging from the brim of her hat.
target: Ea circumiecta inspexit et celeriter rete caeruleum ex orificio pilei pendentem levavit.

source: It wasn’t a woman—it was a man.
target: Non femina erat—sed vir.

source: A man dressed in women’s attire, with distinctive features and grayish-blue eyes that couldn’t conceal the anxiety on his face.
target: Vir in veste feminea indutus, notis distinctis et oculis griseo-caeruleis, qui sollicitudinem in facie non celare poterant.

source: Lumian’s pupils widened.
target: Pupillae Lumiani dilatatae sunt.

source: He recognized the man in the feminine garb.
target: Virum in veste feminea agnovit.

source: It was the current Governor of the Sea!
target: Hic erat praesens Gubernator Maris!

source: The same Governor of the Sea whom Martha had bowed to in the cathedral‐like building, served by numerous maids!
target: Eundem Gubernatorem Maris, quem Martha in aedificio quasi cathedrali, a plurimis ancillis ministrato, reverenter inclinavit!

source: He sought me out? The one coming to me is actually him?
target: Ille me quaesivit? Is, qui ad me venit, vere ille est?

source: Lumian was both astonished and oddly convinced that this made sense.
target: Lumian et obstupuit et mirum modo persuasus est hoc sensum habere.

source: Noticing that the adventurer Louis Berry had identified him, the Governor of the Sea lowered the blue veil, shrouding his face once more.
target: Animadvertens adventorem Ludovicum Berry eum agnovisse, Gubernator Maris velamen caeruleum deiecerat, faciem suam iterum involvens.

source: Then, he hushed his voice and spoke in Highlander, filled with desire and concern, “Save me! Save me!”
target: Tum vocem sedavit et in lingua Highlander locutus est, cupiditate et sollicitudine plenus, "Salva me! Salva me!"
